## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-measurement-estate`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-measurement-estate -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `arena/rounds.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `summary.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `chain/did.json`
- `chain/root.json`
- `harness/README.md`
- `arena/rounds.jsonl`
- `figures/FIGURES.md`
- See the Data tab for all 65 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

**Independent measurement of signed GSPC measurements and banks. Not a certification.**

- Verify any card free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/ · Catalog: https://councilof.ai/catalog.json · Methodology: https://councilof.ai/methodology/
- Live board: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (read today's counts there)

As published in the 2026-09-22 snapshot, not today: 23 axes measured · 14 model fleets · 3 public leader scores · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.

AUTHORITY: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc. This Kaggle copy is a snapshot built 2026-09-22T17:30:34Z from councilof-ai commit c3ae4680f. If the live GET and these files disagree, the live GET wins. A fetch that fails is UNCHECKABLE, never a fabricated 0.

RUN THE REPRODUCTION FIRST. python3 repro/verify_estate.py fetches one signed card live, recomputes id == sha256(canonical(body)), verifies the Ed25519 signature against the key in the live DID document at csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, checks the frozen bank and per-item evidence against the digests pinned in the card, recomputes every prompt, re-derives every graded label with the published rule, and recomputes the accuracy: 9/9 PASS. python3 repro/verify_estate.py --tamper alters one field by 0.0001 and 3 checks FAIL. Both transcripts are in repro/. No dependencies; Ed25519 is implemented in the file from RFC 8032.

WHAT IS HERE: the board as of 2026-09-22 (23 axes, 23 measured on that date) one row per axis · 2433 signed measurement cards with their full bodies and a flat index · 1010 supersessions (a signed card is never edited) · 61 corrections · 1883 arena rounds and the Elo reference with its intervals · 14 frozen banks with their sha256 · every .ots proof with its real state · the ten population doors' free previews · the harness that produces a measurement · six figures, each with the code that drew it · a findings report · the measurement vocabulary as JSON-LD and SKOS (CC0).

WHAT IS NOT HERE: the 1113 per-item evidence files (18 MB) are NOT duplicated onto Kaggle, because Kaggle uploads file by file. evidence/evidence-manifest.jsonl carries every one with its sha256 and its live URL at councilof.ai/interop/mill-evidence/, and the complete 1176-file corpus is at huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-estate.

FOOTPRINT, with its states: 833 packages across three registries (PyPI, npm, Hugging Face — three populations, never added). 395,977 downloads in the last 30 days and 2,635,813 since first release, BOTH state PARTIAL: 832 of 833 counters answered, so each is a lower bound over those, not a total. One PyPI counter returns 404 and its row says so rather than contributing a 0. The two windows are never added to each other, and a download is not a person: mirrors, CI and crawlers are inside both. 34 memberships (32 VERIFIED, 2 PENDING), each naming its evidence and what it does not prove, plus 12 bodies listed as excluded with the reason. 213 capability surfaces declared, 16 of them recorded as an OpenAPI gap.

WHAT THE BOARD SHOWS: 14 model-comparison axes, 0 with a statistically separated leader, 2 TIE, 12 untested. 8 financial/domain axes are deterministic-fact runs with no fleet, no leader and no accuracy: measured is not the same as scored. TIE is a result, not a missing result.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT PROVE: not that any model is best at anything (zero axes separate) · not that a signature makes a measurement correct (a signature over a wrong number is a signed wrong number) · not a certification, conformity assessment, grade or endorsement · not a Bitcoin timestamp for most artifacts (553 of 609 proofs are submitted and calendar-pending, which is a request, not evidence of a time) · not a general ability score (one model, one frozen bank, one day, temperature 0, seed 0).

VERIFY: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify (free, no account) · https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md · keys resolve via did:web:csoai.org.

LICENCES, named per artifact because they differ. Kaggle's licence menu has no plain CC-BY-4.0 entry, so the field reads "other" and the real terms are here: this data CC-BY-4.0 (attribute Council of AI, CSOAI Ltd 16939677, councilof.ai) · the vocabulary in ontology/ CC0-1.0 · the harness, copied verbatim from CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai, MIT · the csoai-gspc and csoai-gspc-mcp packages Apache-2.0.

Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21991104: UNAVAILABLE since 29 Sep 2026 (Zenodo blocked the CSOAI account; appeal pending; status https://councilof.ai/interop/zenodo-status.json). Cite the served methodology: https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md
Issuer: CSOAI Ltd (GB, Companies House 16939677). Measurement, not certification.
